content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197, prior auth missing at time of service. This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer review. An appeal with necessity was already filed and failed to resolve. Since prior auth was required and missing, and the payer offers no path to obtain it retroactively, the claim cannot be collected from the payer. This is a provider administrative failure, so the balance cannot be billed to the patient and should be written off.", "action": "write_off"}
